$comment: Policy for scripts/quality/audit_qt_usage.py (gate G13). Ceilings may only fall: lower them in the commit that removes Qt (audit_qt_usage.py --print-ceilings).

exclude_path_fragments./FormFiles/: Qt Designer generated forms (uic input); not hand-maintained C++.
exclude_path_fragments._autogen/: moc/uic/rcc output; generated at build time.

kept.$comment: Library -> { use: reason } for Qt kept by decision D16.

viz/backends/qt.SvgWriter (QPaintEngine): Replaces QSvgGenerator so the vector export of widgets needs Qt Gui only; dropping the Qt Svg module raised the disp ceilings once (tokens 6025 -> 6159, public header includes 110 -> 112).
viz/backends/qt.QWindow hosts and scene viewports (phase: ChannelWindow (QWindow + QRhi swap chain) next to the ChannelRhiView QRhiWidget host, and SceneViewport replacing the QGraphicsView scenes, raised the disp ceilings once (tokens 4846 -> 4885, public header includes 82 -> 89); the QRhiWidget hosts go with phase 4.
viz/backends/qt.Qt input translation shared with the bra: toScenePointerEvent() and toSceneWheelEvent() (plots/helpers/sceneinput.h), which ChannelRhiRenderer and disp3D's BrainViewCore share instead of each translating Qt events, raised the disp ceilings once (tokens 4543 -> 4549); the brain view's camera, input, layout and overlay moving to mne_scene lowered disp3D from 1961 to 1807 tokens.
viz/backends/qt.QRhi backend of the GPU frame descriptio: RhiFrameRenderer (plots/helpers/rhiframerenderer.h) executes the Qt-free scene::GpuFrame of any view with QRhi: pipelines, buffers, textures and shader reflection checks in one place instead of in each renderer. ChannelRhiRenderer lost its own QRhi code to it, net raising the disp ceilings once (tokens 4529 -> 4546); the brain view moving onto it lowers disp3D.
viz/backends/qt.Generic settings panel builder: SettingsPanel (kit/settingspanel.h) builds the Qt Widgets of any Qt-free scene::SettingsForm, so a new toolkit needs one builder instead of a hand-written view per panel; the builder raised the disp ceilings once (tokens 4546 -> 4601); the covariance, spectrum, averaging, filter, artifact and time-frequency settings views ported onto it lowered them again (tokens 4601 -> 4519). The SPHARA, minimum norm, connectivity and trigger detection settings views followed (viz/backends/qt tokens 5793 -> 5743).
viz/backends/qt.Qt adapters of the Qt-free view models: ChannelInfoModel, FrequencySpectrumModel and BidsViewModel became adapters of mne_viewmodels (ChannelTable, SpectrumTable, BidsTree), and RtFiffRawViewModel and EvokedSetModel hand their SSP, compensator, SPHARA, filtering and trigger detection to mne_dsp (RtRawDisplay, DisplayCorrection). The adapters convert between the view models and QVariant, QStandardItem and QModelIndex, which raised the 'other' category once (1315 -> 1329) while the total fell (tokens 4519 -> 4403).
viz/backends/qt.BrainWindow host and GPU overlay (phase: BrainWindow (QWindow + QRhi swap chain), the forwarding BrainView host and the overlay painted into the GPU pass instead of child QLabels raised the disp3D ceilings once (tokens 1633 -> 1961); the QRhiWidget host goes with phase 4.
viz/backends/qt.One Qt backend library: mne_disp and mne_disp3D merged into mne_viz_qt (src/libs/mne/viz/backends/qt), the Qt backend of mne_viz; their ceilings add up (tokens 4403 + 1807 -> 6208, public header includes 87 + 73 -> 159), minus the two export headers that became one.
viz/backends/qt.QSettings adapter of viz::SettingsStore: QtSettingsStore (qtsettingsstore.h) converts between viz::SettingValue and QVariant so the brain view's per-pane state (SubView, ViewVisibilityProfile) could leave the backend for mne_viz; the QVariant/QMetaType switch raised objects_signals once (657 -> 667) while the move lowered tokens (5942 -> 5922) and public header includes (150 -> 145).
viz/backends/qt.Queued hand-over of Qt-free worker callb: The real-time controllers and SourceEstimateManager hand the std::function callbacks of the workers that moved to viz/brain/realtime over to their own thread with QMetaObject::invokeMethod(..., Qt::QueuedConnection), as the queued signal connections did before; this raised the global category once (950 -> 954) while the move lowered tokens (5857 -> 5805) and public header includes (140 -> 135).
viz/backends/qt.Qt dispatcher of viz::Dispatcher: qtdispatcher.h (queuedDispatcher) posts the tasks of Qt-free brain view models to a QObject's event loop, so SourceEstimateSession and SensorStreamSession could leave the backend; the public header raised public header includes once (135 -> 137) and objects_signals (620 -> 621).
viz/backends/qt.Mipmapped textures of the GPU frame desc: RhiFrameRenderer generating mipmaps for GpuTexture::mipmaps (the depth frame of the video decal) raised the viz/backends/qt ceilings once (tokens 5774 -> 5785, gui 1711 -> 1722); BrainViewCore moving onto BrainFrameBuilder and RhiFrameRenderer lowers them again.
viz/backends/qt.Brain view on the GPU frame description: BrainViewCore records its frames from viz::BrainFrameComposer through RhiFrameRenderer and owns the depth target over the QRhiWidget texture, raising the viz/backends/qt ceilings once (tokens 5785 -> 5793); the superseded BrainRenderer stays as deprecated public API, and its removal lowers them by its QRhi code.
viz/backends/qt.Generic panel host: PanelWidget (kit/panelwidget.h) shows any toolkit-free viz::Panel, and SettingsPanel gained the colour button, colour dialog and toned read-only texts of the new Info and Color fields, raising the gui category once (1725 -> 1733); the compensator and projector views replaced by viz::CompensatorPanel and viz::ProjectorsPanel lowered the total (tokens 5743 -> 5722), the forward settings view replaced by viz::ForwardPanel further (5722 -> 5686), and every further view ported to a panel lowers it again.

qt_modules.$comment: Qt modules each target of mne_viz_qt and the applications may request or use (audit_qt_modules.py --check). Entries may only shrink; a new target gets 'default'. Decisions 2026-11-22: mne_viz_qt (then disp and disp3D) ends at Core, Gui, GuiPrivate (QRhi include path only), ShaderTools (build time) and Widgets; Concurrent and Network are gone (mne::ThreadPool, mne_com); Svg is gone (mne::viz::qt::SvgWriter).
qt_modules.$widgets_free_comment: Files of mne_viz_qt that must not use Qt Widgets (fnmatch on the repository path): the colour maps, scene painter, SVG writer, item models, renderers and QWindow hosts, so the rendering code stays ready for a non-Widgets front end. The widgets themselves live next to them in the same library.
